description: Dual Brake System: Front and rear alloy hand brakes give kids steady, reliable stopping power as they take on longer rides. Perfect Fit™ Frame: A low center of gravity and upright geometry create a natural riding position that helps kids stay balanced and comfortable on every ride. Ready to Ride: A simple single-speed setup keeps kids focused and in control so they can explore their neighborhood with confidence. Comfortable Fit: An adjustable memory foam padded saddle and smaller crank make pedaling easier, helping kids ride smoothly at their own pace. Durable Safety: A full chainguard protects clothing and fingers, while wide, grippy tires add traction and stability on streets and sidewalks.
